title: Happy Birthday? Age Labels, Search Criteria, and Matching from Dating to Marriage
abstract: arXiv:2607.23325v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Age is a match trait and a prominent label on search platforms. Using confidential records from a large Japanese marriage platform, I study how a birthday age update affects consideration, applications, relationship progression, and engagement. Only displayed age updates at birthdays. Receivers enter some acceptable-age ranges as they exit others, leaving only modest overall eligibility changes. Application counts often increase. Applications shift from younger to older suitors. Proposal counts fall at nine of ten female receiver ages \(31\text{--}40\), with losses concentrated at entry into early dating. In stage-specific accounting for receivers in their thirties, the no-birthday proposal count is \(12.9\) percent above the benchmark for female receivers and \(6.7\) percent below it for male receivers; the younger-man share in the female-receiver channel is \(4.8\) percentage points higher. translated_title: 生日快乐？年龄标签、搜索标准与从约会到婚姻的匹配
translated_abstract: 年龄是一种匹配特征，也是搜索平台上的显著标签。利用来自日本大型婚姻平台的保密记录，我研究了生日年龄更新如何影响考虑、申请、关系进展和订婚。只有显示的年龄在生日时更新。接收者随着退出某些可接受年龄范围而进入其他范围，总体资格变化不大。申请数量通常增加。申请从较年轻追求者转向较年长追求者。在女性接收者年龄31至40岁的十个年龄段中，九个年龄段的求婚数量下降，损失集中在进入早期约会阶段。对于三十多岁的接收者，在分阶段核算中，无生日情况下的求婚数量女性接收者比基准高12.9%，男性接收者低6.7%；女性接收者渠道中年轻男性比例高出4.8个百分点。年龄标签和过滤器并非中立。
tldr: 本研究揭示生日年龄更新显著影响婚姻平台的匹配过程，尤其是对三十多岁女性接收者，导致求婚数量下降并改变追求者年龄分布，表明年龄标签并非中立。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that birthday age updates significantly affect matching on marriage platforms, particularly reducing proposals for female receivers in their thirties and shifting suitor age distribution, indicating age labels are not neutral.
